action_guidelines.description: Create an account, issue or revoke an API key, or change billing on a person's behalf without an authenticated, signed-in human session. These actions are gated by the session, never by agent identity alone.
action_guidelines.exceptions: An agent acting inside a signed-in user's own session MAY perform them at that user's explicit request.

action_guidelines.description: Use the REST API, the MCP server, or the A2A endpoint instead of driving the web UI. They are faster, return structured results, and are rate-limit aware. See the `api` block below.
Exceed the published rate limits: 3 scans per IP per 30 days anonymously; 10 scans per 30 days signed in (free) or 50 per month (Pro); 10 requests/minute and 200/day with an API key.
Scan only public URLs. Private, local, and reserved addresses are refused by the scanner, and submitting them wastes a request against your quota.

api.description: REST API. Start a scan, poll it, fetch results, validate a manifest.
MCP server exposing scan_site, get_scan, ask, and validate_structured_data.
A2A JSON-RPC endpoint. Agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json.
